rows.action: Establish MAIN, ENGINE, G1 and G2 and query both job layers.
rows.expect: MAIN in the unit job only; ENGINE, G1 and G2 in both jobs; exact creation times, parents, inner flags and token identity; children running, not merely created.

rows.action: MAIN closes its sole inner handle while it keeps running.
rows.expect: ENGINE, G1 and G2 signal without unit-job termination or an observer job duplicate; MAIN stays responsive and in the unit job until the final stop.

rows.action: Explicit stop with a cooperative ExecStop helper.
rows.expect: Helper runs once for the captured main; inner descendants, MAIN and helper exit; stop succeeds; no restart afterwards.

rows.action: Hung ExecStop helper and a MAIN that ignores the request, TimeoutStopSec=5s.
rows.expect: Forced cleanup removes both jobs' processes and the helper; stop reports failure within the budget; explicit stop stays down.

rows.action: Terminate the exact MAIN process under Restart=always.
rows.expect: Loss of the sole inner handle kills the engine tree; every old handle signals before the replacement launch; the new generation and invocation are contained.

rows.action: Crash the exact headless user-manager process with the unit enabled.
rows.expect: Old manager, MAIN, ENGINE, G1 and G2 are gone before the replacement workload is accepted; a new S4U manager recovers enabled work.

rows.action: Crash the process that owns the outer jobs (broker, or the owner-lane helper).
rows.expect: The old managed tree exits; with the installed daemon, recovery restores the enabled workload and no old generation survives at replacement acceptance.

rows.action: ENGINE, G1 and G2 commit 96 MiB each under MemoryMax=256M.
rows.expect: The unit-job commit limit is enforced and reported as a resource limit; the inner job has no limit to credit; the whole tree is cleaned up.

rows.action: Format 1 CPUQuota=25% with busy descendants, compared with an uncapped control.
rows.expect: Native CpuRate 2500 with a hard cap on the unit job, none on the inner job; measured use within the declared bound, or explicitly inconclusive.

rows.action: Format 2 WindowsCPUQuota=25%, same control and measurement.
rows.expect: Same native and measured scope as N09 using the format 2 directive.

rows.action: MAIN, ENGINE and G1 request CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB with no inner breakaway flags.
rows.expect: No created process is outside the unit job; every attempt and its result is recorded.

rows.action: After READY, set only inner BREAKAWAY_OK; ENGINE and G1 request breakaway for new probes.
rows.expect: Probes may leave the inner job but never the unit job; existing members keep inner membership; the unit stop removes every process.

rows.action: After READY, set only inner SILENT_BREAKAWAY_OK; ENGINE and G1 create normal probes.
rows.expect: Probes stay in the unit job even when they leave the inner job; the unit stop removes every process.

rows.action: Kill MAIN at a held launch gate.
rows.expect: The child's primary thread is still suspended; an unassigned child remains contained by the unit job, an assigned or atomically created child dies with the inner job; every child is drained before replacement.

rows.action: Sensitivity control: ENGINE deliberately inherits one inner-job duplicate; MAIN closes both of its copies, then ENGINE closes the last one.
rows.expect: The probe detects the inherited job; the tree survives MAIN's close and dies after ENGINE's. Not a safe production lane.

rows.action: Test-only seam fails the first stop of a real nested tree; stop, start and retry.
rows.expect: Ownership is retained and replacement is refused while cleanup is unconfirmed; the retry drains every held process.
